title: The Elven Embassy
description: Ambassador Liraethel was riding to Dalhurst to seal a treaty and never arrived. Severin Vane thinks somebody wanted the treaty dead more than the woman. Elves do not forgive an insult delivered by silence.

objectives.description: Investigate the ambassador's last known location on the eastern road
Find evidence of what happened to the ambassador
Track the captors to their hideout
Defeat the cultists holding the ambassador
Recover the treaty - unsigned is as bad as destroyed
Escort the ambassador safely to the Elven outpost

notes: Improved threat, giver motive and consequence without touching bible [OPEN]s: did not place Silvanost geographically beyond what's already shipped (harbor_master_dalhurst.json already names it the elven city reachable by boat), did not touch the elixir, the missing king, or the elf claimant and her son. Treaty content invented as road-access and legal-jurisdiction terms - deliberately not the elixir or the succession, to stay clear of those opens. Consequence stated in prose: elves read a silent failure as an insult, not an accident, and the peace resets by a generation. This remains a single linear kill-and-retrieve quest with no branch - the audit's other complaint about the missing consequence data is out of scope for a description-only pass.
